ValidationRule.description: When a Subscription Opportunity moves on from Demo Completed to a later stage (Proposal, Contract or Closed Won), requires Date Demo Booked. Moving back a stage or to Closed Lost isn't blocked. Honors the On/Off Switch (Run Validation Rules).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Setup.On_Off_Switch__c.Run_Validation_Rules__c && BEGINS(RecordType.DeveloperName, "Subscription_") && ISCHANGED(StageName) && ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Demo Completed") && ( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Proposal") || ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Contract") || ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won") ) && ISBLANK(Date_Demo_Booked__c)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before moving on from Demo Completed, please complete Date Demo Booked.
